description: Get one Subframe Motion Library example: its complete React source; how it looks and moves; adapt notes naming the code that drives the motion and what to change; the npm packages to install (none means React only); the images its code loads from /motion/assets/ with download URLs (serve them there or change the paths); reduced-motion behavior and limitations; its licence and upstream credit; related examples; the guidance topics worth reading; and a preview image. Use a slug from search_motion_examples or from a www.subframe.com/motion/<slug> URL. This writes no files: adapt the code to the project, keep its licence header, and test it there. The code targets React 19; with React 18 server rendering, move its inline <style> CSS into a stylesheet, since React 18 escapes the CSS's quotes and > characters.
name: get_motion_example
title: Get Motion Example
